title.en: Reading concrete pump rubber spring φ230 with the section names of Cantilever bridge
title.zh: 用来源页《Cantilever bridge》的章节名来读concrete pump rubber spring φ230

description.en: Cantilever bridge provides the section names for concrete pump rubber spring φ230. The φ230 spring is one piece-row on the Xingtai rubber-spring page. Printed materials for this row: rubber and polyurethane. It is a damping spring for a concrete-pump piston, not the piston itself.
description.zh: 《Cantilever bridge》为concrete pump rubber spring φ230提供章节名。φ230 弹簧是邢台橡胶弹簧页上的一行，按个。这一行印出的材料：橡胶和聚氨酯。它是混凝土泵活塞用的缓冲弹簧，不是活塞本身。

h1.en: concrete pump rubber spring φ230 without figures beyond the row, under Cantilever bridge
h1.zh: concrete pump rubber spring φ230不超出已印行，标题来自《Cantilever bridge》

directAnswer.en: concrete pump rubber spring φ230 is restated below in Hebei Pinjin Machinery’s own catalogue words. The section order is the order of Cantilever bridge, and that page is not a second nameplate. The φ230 spring is one piece-row on the Xingtai rubber-spring page. Printed materials for this row: rubber and polyurethane. It is a damping spring for a concrete-pump piston, not the piston itself.
directAnswer.zh: concrete pump rubber spring φ230下面用河北品锦机械目录里已经有的说法重述。章节次序来自《Cantilever bridge》，那一页不是第二块铭牌。 φ230 弹簧是邢台橡胶弹簧页上的一行，按个。这一行印出的材料：橡胶和聚氨酯。它是混凝土泵活塞用的缓冲弹簧，不是活塞本身。

body.en: The contents list of the source page includes “Origins”. This section borrows that name and then repeats a printed fragment. The page lists φ150, φ180, φ200, φ230, φ235 and φ260. Rubber rows are φ150, φ180, φ200, φ230 and φ260. Polyurethane rows are φ200, φ230, φ235 and φ260. This φ230 row is rubber and polyurethane. Unit: piece. Hardness and service life are missing. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A split or integral piston at φ230, where that size exists, is a different product page and a different unit. φ235 is on the spring page only. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 来源页目录里有“来源章节：Origins”。本节借用这个名字，然后复述已经印出的片段。 页面列出 φ150、φ180、φ200、φ230、φ235、φ260。橡胶行是 φ150、φ180、φ200、φ230、φ260。聚氨酯行是 φ200、φ230、φ235、φ260。φ230 这一行是橡胶和聚氨酯。单位：个。硬度和寿命缺失。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 若分体或整体活塞也有 φ230，那是另一张产品页，单位也不同。φ235 只在弹簧页上。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: Read “Function” as the source author’s section, not as a Pinjin test result. The sentence that follows is the printed fragment. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write rubber spring or polyurethane spring, φ230, and the quantity in pieces, matching the material row above. The φ230 spring is one piece-row on the Xingtai rubber-spring page. Printed materials for this row: rubber and polyurethane. It is a damping spring for a concrete-pump piston, not the piston itself. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 把“函数”读成来源作者的分节，不要读成品锦的试验结果。后面跟的是已印片段。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 按上面的材料行写橡胶弹簧或聚氨酯弹簧、φ230 和个数。 φ230 弹簧是邢台橡胶弹簧页上的一行，按个。这一行印出的材料：橡胶和聚氨酯。它是混凝土泵活塞用的缓冲弹簧，不是活塞本身。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Construction methods”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“构造方法”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “List by length”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“来源章节：List by length”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Examples”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 橡胶弹簧 page plus this size and the quantity. The outline does not complete a blank. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cantilever_bridge
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“例子”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明橡胶弹簧这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 大纲补不上空白格子。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cantilever_bridge
